<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: right; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>Exhibit
10.7</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: center; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Certain schedules and exhibits to this agreement have been omitted pursuant to Item 601(a)(5) of Regulation S-K. A copy of any omitted
schedule and/or exhibit will be furnished supplementally to the SEC upon request.&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: center; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">[***] Certain information in this document has been excluded pursuant to Regulation S-K, Item 601(a)(6). Such excluded information is
not material and is the type that the registrant treats as private or confidential.&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><IMG SRC="tm2528763d6_ex10-7img001.jpg" ALT="">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><I>S&amp;P
Global</I>&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><I>55
Water Street</I>&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><I>New
York, New York 10041</I></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">November&nbsp;10,
2025</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Joe
LaFeir&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">[***]</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Dear
Joe,</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Congratulations
on your new position as President, Mobility Business Solutions, S&amp;P Global Mobility (&ldquo;Mobility&rdquo;)! We are delighted with
your success and look forward to your continued leadership. You will be starting in your position on September&nbsp;3, 2025 with a principal
location of Michigan or such other date or location as may be agreed to by the Company in writing, reporting to Bill Eager. This offer
is contingent on your beginning employment as indicated above.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Your
payroll employer entity is IHS Global Inc. (together with S&amp;P Global Inc., the &ldquo;Company&rdquo;) and you will be paid an annualized
salary of $475,000.00 USD on a bi-weekly basis (except where local law requires more frequent payment), less lawful deductions. This
position is classified as exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) and therefore is not eligible for overtime pay.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">You
will be eligible to participate in the applicable annual bonus plan (&ldquo;Bonus Plan&rdquo;) with a target incentive opportunity of
$380,000.00 USD. Actual payment under the Bonus Plan, if any, will be based on the degree of achievement of the established company and/or
division objective(s)&nbsp;and your individual performance and contribution, as determined in the Company&rsquo;s discretion. Awards
may be less than the communicated target and are subject to your People Leader&rsquo;s assessment of your performance. Please note that
your target opportunity and eligibility are not commitments to pay any award, as all payments under the Bonus Plan are discretionary.
Target opportunities are subject to change by the Company in its discretion from year to year. Further, to receive a payment, you must
be an employee in good standing and be employed by the Company, or any of its business units, on the Bonus Plan payout date<I>.</I></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">You
will also be eligible to participate in the S&amp;P Global Long-Term Stock Incentive Program. Under this Program, for 2026, you will
be eligible to receive a long-term incentive grant that, if approved by the Compensation and Leadership Development Committee of the
Company&rsquo;s Board of Directors (the &ldquo;Compensation Committee&rdquo;) or its authorized delegate and granted, will be a target
value of $700,000.00 USD. Any such grant will be subject in all respects (including, but not limited to, with respect to vesting) to
the terms and conditions of the S&amp;P Global Long-Term Stock Incentive Program under the S&amp;P Global Inc. 2019 Stock Incentive Plan,
as applicable, and the associated award agreement that you receive at the time of grant. In addition, you may also be eligible to receive
future long-term incentive grants, as determined by the Compensation Committee in its sole discretion, subject to the terms and conditions
of the then-applicable S&amp;P Global Long-Term Stock Incentive Program. For the avoidance of doubt, any long-term incentive grant you
receive in 2026 is not a guarantee that the same or a similar award will be made in future years, and there is no assurance that any
future long-term incentive awards will be made.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Effective
with your employment, you will participate in the Management Supplemental Death and Disability Plan, which provides for pre-retirement
death benefits equal to two times your annual base salary. Should you become disabled while employed by S&amp;P Global, you shall be
provided with a monthly disability income benefit, as defined under the Plan and reduced by certain plan-specified offsets.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><IMG SRC="tm2528763d6_ex10-7img001.jpg" ALT="">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Also,
you are subject to all eligible policies of S&amp;P Global. You must enroll in all benefit plans within your first thirty days, and benefit
coverage is retroactive to your Start Date. Please <U>click here</U> to review information regarding the benefits available to employees
of S&amp;P Global.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">S&amp;P
Global has a flexible paid time off program (called &ldquo;Recharge&rdquo;). Additional information about our Recharge program can be
found <U>here</U>.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">To
facilitate an effective transition, in the event you choose to leave the Company, you must provide the Company with 90-days&rsquo; written
notice to the Chief People Officer. You agree that the notice period required is reasonable and necessary to assist the Company in a
transition period. You understand that the Company may, at its discretion, shorten the time of the notice period either before or after
you give the notice, but your separation will still be considered a resignation. You acknowledge and agree that you have a duty to notify
any new employer(s)&nbsp;of the existence of this obligation and its restrictions and hereby grant consent to Company to inform any new
employer(s)&nbsp;of the restrictions under this obligation.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">All
employees are required to adhere to the Company&rsquo;s Code of Business Ethics (the &ldquo;<U>COBE</U>&rdquo;) and Securities Disclosure
Policy throughout their employment, including any notice periods (whether worked, not worked or &ldquo;garden leave&rdquo;).&#8239; The
purpose of the COBE and the Securities Disclosure Policy is to establish guidelines reasonably designed to identify and prevent recipients
form breaching any applicable fiduciary duties and to deal with other situations that may pose a conflict of interest or the appearance
of a conflict of interest.&#8239;In addition, there are divisions of S&amp;P Global that require affirmations to a Code of Conduct, Code
of Business Ethics and/or a Securities Disclosure Policy. The purpose of the Code of Conduct is to reflect the high&minus;level principles
that govern the conduct of the Company&rsquo;s Credit Rating Activities. Failure to comply with Company policies, including the COBE
and Securities Disclosure Policy, may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination of employment. &#8239;All violations
or potential violations of the COBE of which you become aware, should be reported promptly to the People Team. &#8239;Each year, you
will be required to sign or otherwise indicate your assent to an Affirmation Statement to confirm that you have reviewed the COBE and
understand your continuing obligation to comply with its terms.&#8239; Periodic certifications relating to the Securities Disclosure
Policy are also required. &#8239;Please note that the Securities Disclosure Policy includes requirements that may extend to an employee&rsquo;s
immediate family (as defined in the policy), and that for some positions the applicable policies may impact your ability to maintain
and conduct trades of certain holdings.&#8239; To the extent that the COBE and Securities Disclosure Policy, or compliance therewith,
would be inconsistent with applicable law, applicable law will govern. Any questions relating to the &ldquo;Codes&rdquo; or the Securities
Disclosure Policy should be directed to [***].</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">By
accepting this letter of offer, you acknowledge that you are aware that your personal data will be handled in accordance with the S&amp;P
Global <U>Employee Privacy Policy (Applicable to U.S.,&nbsp;India and Pakistan</U>). This policy means that your data may be collected,
transferred, disclosed, stored or otherwise processed in S&amp;P Global and its affiliates&rsquo; systems, as well as the systems of
service providers, that may be located in a jurisdiction which is different to your work location and where the data privacy laws may
be different to the laws in your work location. Please take a moment to review the Policy before accepting this letter of offer. S&amp;P
Global updates its policies from time to time. If you have any questions about the applicable Policy now or in the future, please contact
[***].</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">This
letter is not an offer of a contract of employment. It is the Company&rsquo;s policy that all employment is &ldquo;at-will.&rdquo; This
means either the employee or the Company may terminate employment for any reason at any time. No change in the &ldquo;at-will&rdquo;
employment relationship is valid unless it is contained in a written agreement signed by <U>an authorized officer</U> of S&amp;P Global.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Federal
law requires U.S. employers to verify that all new employees are eligible to work in the United States pursuant to the Immigration Reform
and Control Act of 1986. As a condition of your employment, as set forth by the Act, you will be required to provide proof of identity
and employment authorization within three (3)&nbsp;days of your Hire Date by completing the Form&nbsp;I-9. Shortly after offer acceptance,
you will receive an email communication from the S&amp;P Global Onboarding team with instructions on how to complete your pre-boarding
tasks including updating personal information and I-9 requirements.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><IMG SRC="tm2528763d6_ex10-7img001.jpg" ALT=""></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">If
you require immigration sponsorship by S&amp;P Global now or in the future, in order to accept or continue employment with us, we reserve
the right to determine whether to pursue a nonimmigrant case on your behalf. Further, you should be aware that there is no guarantee
that the government will approve any such case that we do file on your behalf. By accepting this offer, you represent that you are not
aware of any circumstances that would make you ineligible for nonimmigrant status. Please note also that by sponsoring you for nonimmigrant
work status, S&amp;P Global is not committing to sponsoring you for permanent resident status.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">You
acknowledge and agree that terms and conditions set forth in <B>Attachment A (Agreement for the Protection of Company Interests) </B>hereto
are hereby incorporated into, and are part of, the terms and conditions of this offer letter. You acknowledge that you have reviewed
and understand the terms of the Agreement for the Protection of Company Interests, and that by accepting this offer letter you are accepting
the terms in Attachment A, including the non-solicitation of employees, confidentiality and ownership of information provisions.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">You
represent that you are free to enter into an employment relationship with the Company and to perform the services required of you. You
also represent that you have disclosed to the Company and provided copies of any agreement you may have with any third party (such as
a former employer) which may limit your ability to work for the Company, or which otherwise could create a conflict of interest with
the Company. You further represent that you are not bound by any non-competition, non-disclosure, non-solicitation, or similar obligations,
except for those contained in the written agreements you have provided to the Company. Finally, please understand that you are strictly
prohibited from using or disclosing any confidential information or materials of any former employer or other third party to whom you
have an obligation of confidentiality and from violating any lawful agreement that you may have with any third party.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">You
will receive a notification requesting you to provide an e-signature to accept this offer.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">If
you have any questions, please do not hesitate to call me.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
